attribution.note: Zitron directly states and endorses both assertions.

semantics.note: The normalisation preserves the capacity threshold, duration range and historical gigawatt assertion. The surrounding context acknowledges exceptional conversions.

contract.note: Reading the duration as an ordinary full-project range is fair given the acknowledged conversion exception. Matching capacity and completion to the same project boundary reasonably distinguishes completed facilities from announced expansions.

evidence.note: A dated industry benchmark for exactly 50 MW. It does not establish actual completion durations for the claimed population above 50 MW.
A relevant company disclosure asserting operational gigawatt scale. It challenges the claim but lacks a capacity definition and documentation establishing completion under the contract.

Published before the evaluation cutoff, this retrospective assessment documents incomplete April infrastructure and estimates IT power. It qualifies the January disclosure without settling May 12 capacity or worldwide absence.
Its methodology distinguishes reaching a gigawatt from completing a campus. It supplies no qualifying completion record that settles either assertion.

reviews.rationale: The packet lacks representative completion records above 50 MW and a sufficiently broad inventory of completed gigawatt facilities. The operational gigawatt announcement is material contrary evidence, but its capacity and completion status remain unconfirmed. Neither component is settled.
